t: A fast two-brained Arduino module built for vision, factories and labs.
steps: Buy a Portenta H7 from the Arduino store or a distributor such as DigiKey.
Pick a carrier such as the Breakout board or the Vision Shield for your project.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the Arduino Mbed OS Portenta board package.
Choose Portenta H7 from the board menu and pick its port.
Open the Blink example and press Upload.
Try a Wi-Fi scan example next and see nearby networks in the Serial Monitor.
meta: Open Board. From $114. A few stores.
